room_rent.note: Policy covers single room; if higher room category is occupied, proportionate deduction applies on associated medical expenses in addition to room rent difference.

icu.note: ICU charges covered under Section 3.1 with no separate sub-limit mentioned; subject to sum insured.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-payment mentioned in the policy wording.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure-wise monetary sub-limits found in the wording. All covered benefits are up to the Base Sum Insured.

deductible.note: No aggregate or base deductible mentioned.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; not applicable for accidents.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing disease waiting period is 36 months across all plans (A, B, C). No optional reduction mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: Specified disease/procedure waiting period is 24 months across all plans.

maternity.note: Maternity is a standard exclusion (Excl18). Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: Guaranteed Bonus accrues at 25% of Base Sum Insured per year, up to a maximum of 200% of BSI. Applies on renewal without claim requirement.

restoration.note: Automatic restoration of Base Sum Insured up to 100%, unlimited number of times per policy year. Restored SI can be used for all subsequent claims including same illness.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 90 days prior to hospitalisation.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 180 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day Care Treatment for all eligible procedures covered under Section 3.1.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered for at least 3 consecutive days, up to Base Sum Insured.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to Base Sum Insured at recognised AYUSH hospitals. Pre/post-hospitalisation not covered for AYUSH.

organ_donor.note: Living donor harvesting expenses covered up to Base Sum Insured when insured is the recipient.

ambulance.display: Covered up to SI (road); Air ambulance ₹5L
ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to Base Sum Insured (no separate cap stated). Air ambulance covered up to ₹5 lakh separately (does not reduce Base SI).

modern_treatments.note: All 12 listed modern treatments (robotic surgery, oral chemo, intra-vitreal injections, etc.) covered under Section 3.1 up to Sum Insured.

consumables.note: Non-payable items under List I are covered under Section 3.11 as an inbuilt benefit, subject to Sum Insured.

global_cover.note: Treatment outside India explicitly excluded (Section 4.2.10). Coverage limited to India only.

moratorium.note: After 5 continuous years, no look-back on claims except for proven fraud.

grace_period.note: 30-day grace period for annual renewal. For monthly instalments, 15 days; for half-yearly/quarterly, 30 days.

free_look.note: Applicable on new policies only; not on renewals or porting/migration.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines.

notable_exclusions.display: OPD treatment, maternity, external congenital anomaly, treatment outside India, hearing aids, cosmetic surgery, self-inflicted injury

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in this policy wording.
